description: This file defines the 'Tax' class within the Opencart e-commerce system, handling tax calculations, address-based tax rule setting, and tax rate retrieval.

classes.name: Tax
classes.description: A class managing tax rules, rates, and calculations based on different addresses within the Opencart system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Tax class with database and configuration objects from the registry.

methods.name: setShippingAddress
methods.description: Sets tax rates based on the shipping address (country and zone).

methods.name: setPaymentAddress
methods.description: Sets tax rates based on the payment address (country and zone).

methods.name: setStoreAddress
methods.description: Sets tax rates based on the store address (country and zone).

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates total amount including tax for a given value and tax class.

methods.name: getTax
methods.description: Retrieves the total tax amount for a given value and tax class.

methods.name: getRateName
methods.description: Returns the name of a tax rate given its ID.

methods.name: getRates
methods.description: Retrieves detailed tax rate data for a value and tax class.
